title: Creeper
label: Roll Deep Recordings

type.basis: A Roll Deep Recordings instrumental (RDR 001), made in 2002, that Risky Roadz recalls Slimzee dropping on Pay As U Go sets; adds the string-led strand to the type series.

sound.text: An instrumental riddim built on 'echoed strings' that Risky Roadz calls 'so creepy', far removed from UK garage's fluffiness (Complex, 2017).

context.text: Complex says it was made in 2002; Risky Roadz recalls it as one of the tunes Slimzee dropped on Pay As U Go sets, and wanting to buy it at Rhythm Division.
Complex calls it one of grime's most iconic instrumentals. Risky Roadz made an official video about 15 years after release, in 2017.
RBMA Daily says Wiley met Danny Weed at Bow Boys, a local secondary school, and lists him among Wiley's old estate friends.

uncertainty: Complex says it was 'made' in 2002. Search-result titles for Discogs also say 2002, but Discogs could not be opened. The Vinyl Exchange listing gives the label and catalogue number but no year. The listed A-side 'Remix' may belong to a reissue rather than the first pressing.
tracklist: A: 'Creeper (Remix)'; B: 'Creeper (Original Mix)' (from the Vinyl Exchange listing). Instrumental.
